AutoRenew.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled. This parameter takes effect only when EcsChargeType is set to PrePaid. Valid values:
true: Auto-renewal is enabled.
false: Auto-renewal is disabled.

Default value: true
AutoRenew.description_zh:
是否自动续费，当参数EcsChargeType取值为PrePaid时才生效。取值范围：
true：自动续费
false：不自动续费

默认值：true

AutoRenewPeriod.description_en:
The duration of each auto-renewal. This parameter takes effect when AutoRenew is set to true.
If PeriodUnit is set to Week, valid values of AutoRenewPeriod are 1, 2, and 3.
If PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values of AutoRenewPeriod are 1, 2, 3, 6, and 12.

Default value: 1
AutoRenewPeriod.description_zh:
每次自动续费的时长。参数AutoRenew取值true时生效。
PeriodUnit为Week时，AutoRenewPeriod取值{"1", "2", "3"}。
PeriodUnit为Month时，AutoRenewPeriod取值{"1", "2", "3", "6", "12"}。

默认值：1

ComputeSpotPriceLimit.description_en: The maximum hourly price for compute nodes. The value can have up to three decimal places. This parameter takes effect only when ComputeSpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit
ComputeSpotPriceLimit.description_zh: 计算节点每小时最高价格。最大支持3位小数，参数ComputeSpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时生效

ComputeSpotStrategy.description_en:
The bidding policy for compute nodes. Valid values:
NoSpot: The compute nodes are pay-as-you-go instances.
SpotWithPriceLimit: The compute nodes are spot instances with a maximum hourly price.
SpotAsPriceGo: The compute nodes are spot instances for which the system automatically bids based on the current market price
ComputeSpotStrategy.description_zh:
计算节点竞价策略。可能值：
NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格

DeployMode.description_en:
The cluster deployment mode. Valid values:
Standard: The domain account node, scheduling node, logon node, and compute nodes are deployed separately.
Advanced: HA mode deployment.
Simple: The domain account node and scheduling node are deployed on the same node. The logon node and compute nodes are deployed separately.
Tiny: The domain account node, scheduling node, and logon node are deployed on the same node. The compute nodes are deployed separately
DeployMode.description_zh:
集群部署模式。可能值：
Standard：账号节点、调度节点、登录节点、计算节点分离部署。
Advanced：HA模式部署。
Simple：账号节点和调度节点混合部署在一个节点上，登录节点和计算节点分离部署。
Tiny：账号节点、调度节点、登录节点混合部署在一个节点上，计算节点分离部署

Plugin.description_en:
The plug-in pattern configuration. This parameter takes effect only when SchedulerType is set to custom.

The value is a JSON format character string that contains the pluginMod, pluginLocalPath, and pluginOssPath parameters. The metric description is as follows:

pluginMod: the plug-in pattern. The following two patterns are supported:
  
oss: The plug-in is downloaded from OSS and extracted to the local pluginLocalPath folder.

image: The plug-in is already placed in the pluginLocalPath folder by default.

pluginLocalPath: the local path where the plug-in is stored. Use a shared storage folder for oss pattern and a non-shared storage folder for image pattern.

pluginOssPath: the remote path of the plug-in on OSS. This parameter takes effect only when pluginMod is set to oss
Plugin.description_zh:
插件模式配置，仅当SchedulerType为custom生效。

格式为JSON字符串，包含pluginMod、pluginLocalPath、pluginOssPath三个参数，具体参数说明如下：

pluginMod：插件模式，支持以下两种模式：
  
oss模式：将从OSS上下载插件解压到本地pluginLocalPath中。

image模式：默认插件已经放置到pluginLocalPath。

pluginLocalPath：插件存放的本地路径，建议在oss模式下选择共享存储目录，image模式下选择非共享存储目录。

pluginOssPath：插件放置在OSS上的远程路径，仅当pluginMod等于oss生效
